name: Blade Quest
source:
"Oh, the outrage, m'lady!.."
The outrage of showing yourself in human circles, when you can't be possibly called human at night.

"Oh, the indecency, m'lady!.."
The indecency of pushing the limits when you're a good, well-bred girl.

"It's not allowed, m'lady!.."
It's not allowed to steal magic toys from suspicious old ladies.

"You should be ashamed of yourself, m'lady!"
What are you up to this beautiful morning, m'lady? Going to run away and get loose?

When everyone around you cares only about keeping their faces straight, protecting - hiding! - you from the world, there comes a time to make a stand. Just as you see fit.
translation:
“噢，太令人愤怒了，女士！……”
当你在晚上不可能被称为人类时，在人类圈子中展示自己的愤怒。

“噢，太不雅了，女士！……”
当你是一个有教养的好女孩时，挑战极限是不雅的。

“这是不允许的，女士！……”
不可以从可疑的老太太那里偷魔法玩具。

“你应该为自己感到羞耻，女士！”
女士们，这个美丽的早晨你打算做什么？想要逃跑并逃脱吗？

当你周围的每个人都只关心板着脸、保护——隐藏！- 来自世界各地的你，是时候表明立场了。正如你认为合适的那样。
